claims.qualification: Previous any-alarm model at frozen threshold 0.3345231006565093; 4,400 warnings on 14,040 object-days. Not the top-10 refit control.
Same 1,800 warnings, 10/day, same 2,000 registered onsets, 78 objects × 180 days. Baseline is any_alarm_refit. Target alarm(D+1)=0 and alarm(D+2)=1. Known 2026 period, not a new blind test.
Relative hit gain at equal warning budget, not +37.7 percentage points and not physical failures prevented.

claims.claim: No-alarm warnings 1,032 vs 508; any-alarm Precision 42.67% vs 71.78%
claims.qualification: Repeated alarms are valid for the old any-alarm goal; the onset candidate does not dominate that goal. No registered alarm is not adjudicated false physical-alarm evidence.

claims.claim: 75 of 119 net additional onset hits follow a day without records
claims.qualification: Retrospective diagnostic stratum, not an inference filter. Net difference 110−35; not 75 uniquely won incidents. Missing records do not mean healthy equipment.

claims.claim: 116 Python tests and 7 asynchronous UI scenarios
claims.qualification: Saved successful runs; suite was not re-executed by this claims audit. Async test uses actual UI script with a minimal DOM double; no claim of 123 browser tests or full production compliance.

claims.claim: 313.5 million records, 8 annual archives, 78 modeled objects
claims.qualification: 313.5m is the inspected raw journal corpus, not a claim that the onset model trained on every record. 78 objects have mapped channels; object registry has 95 entries. Archive existence and sizes rechecked, not full archive SHA recomputation.
